name: pull-request-reviews-opencode
title: Pull request reviews on an open model
description: The pull request reviewer as OpenCode on an open-weight model through a model connection such as OpenRouter: its image and reviewer, replacing the pull-request-reviews pack's.
docs:
Install after `pull-request-reviews`: its image and reviewer replace that pack's, and everything else stays. The reviewer is OpenCode, run by Work as an ACP agent in the review sandbox, on a model connection; the image configures OpenCode for the Work gateway and ignores the pull request's own OpenCode settings.

1. Copy both files over the review pack's.
2. Bind the model connection in the `review` Environment's `connections`, with the exact model ids it serves:

```json
"model": {
  "provider": "openrouter",
  "principal": "service",
  "service": "openrouter",
  "model": { "allow": ["deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash"] }
}
```

3. To use another model, change it in three places together: the image's OpenCode configuration (`models` and `model`), the reviewer's `model`, and the binding's `model.allow`.

The connection is the server's, and so is the routing: which providers an aggregator such as OpenRouter may send the prompts to is a rewrite in the server's own image (the Work server guide's "Harnesses on the server").
